highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Founded in 1958, Monash University has quickly risen to become one of the world's most prestigious research institutions. As a member of the Group of Eight (Go8), it is recognised for its academic excellence and massive global footprint, with a student population of over 78,000. You can choose from a vast array of disciplines across faculties such as Engineering, Pharmacy, Law, Medicine, and Business. Its reputation for research is world-class, hosting major facilities like the Australian Synchrotron right next to its flagship campus.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At Monash, you’re part of a massive international community with students from over 150 countries. You can join over 100 student clubs and societies, ranging from the Monash Association of Coding to the Indian Cultural Society and various sports clubs. The university provides extensive support for your wellbeing and academic growth, ensuring you feel settled whether you are on campus in Melbourne or at one of its international locations.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
You have several on-campus living options at Monash, especially at the Clayton campus, from traditional student communities to modern, studio-style apartments.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library

The Monash University library system is extensive, featuring major hubs like the Sir Louis Matheson Library

(Clayton) and the Caulfield Library. You’ll have access to specialised collections, including the Ada Booth Slavic Collection and various medical and rare book archives.

Sports

Monash Sport manages high-quality fitness centres, swimming pools, and athletic tracks. You can access gyms, basketball courts, and join competitive sporting clubs at the Clayton and Peninsula campuses.

Laboratories

You’ll learn in world-class environments such as the Monash Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences

labs or specialised engineering and science research facilities.

Cafeteria

Campus dining is diverse. You can grab a meal at Halls Cafe, enjoy coffee at Grafali’s Coffee Roasters, or visit popular spots like Guzman y Gomez, PappaRich, and Sushi Sushi.
